subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#3 NOT MET — live_preview is dead code. setCommonConfig (lines 113-116) destructures live_preview and calls (query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash), but NONE of the 5 public functions (getEntry line 192, getSingleEntry line 252, getAllContentTypeEntries line 293, findSingletonEntry line 338, getSingletonEntry line 385) destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. They all use explicit destructuring (e.g., { contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, lang, includeFields }) without a rest operator, so live_preview is silently dropped at every call site. The parameter types (IContentstackGetEntry etc.) extend ICommonContentstackConfig and thus allow live_preview, but the functions never pass it through. setCommonConfig's live_preview handling is unreachable dead code — preview context can never flow through to Contentstack queries, directly contradicting AC#3 and prior review feedback: 'query config interfaces lack live_preview fields to forward preview context through to Contentstack queries'.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the destructuring of each public function and pass it through to the factory method call. For getEntry: destructure { contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, lang, includeFields, live_preview } and include live_preview in the createContentTypeQuery call object. Repeat for getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry, and getSingletonEntry.

issues.description: No test verifies that live_preview context actually flows through a public function (getEntry, getSingleEntry, etc.) to the Contentstack query's addParam method. The 3 new tests (lines 440-477) only check the options object and setHost behavior. Since the forwarding code in setCommonConfig is dead code (see blocker above), no test catches this regression. A test that calls getEntry (or similar) with a live_preview parameter and asserts that the mock's addParam method was called with the correct value is required to prove AC#3 is met.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test that calls getEntry (or getSingleEntry) with a live_preview: { preview_hash: 'test-hash' } parameter and asserts that the query mock's addParam was called with ('live_preview', 'test-hash'). Also add addParam: jest.fn().mockReturnThis() to the contentstack mock at line 14, since the mock currently lacks this method and any test exercising the live_preview path would crash with 'addParam is not a function'.

issues.description: The contentstack mock object lacks an addParam method. setCommonConfig calls (query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash) (line 116). If the forwarding blocker is fixed and any test passes live_preview through a public function to setCommonConfig, the test will crash with 'addParam is not a function' because the mock object has no such method.
issues.suggestedFix: Add addParam: jest.fn().mockReturnThis() to the jest.mock('contentstack') Stack factory mock object, alongside the existing except, only, where, etc. mocks.
